text: Praise{H1984} ye Jehovah.{H3050} Blessed{H835} is the man{H376} that feareth{H3372} Jehovah,{H3050} That delighteth{H2654} greatly{H3966} in his commandments.{H4687}
His seed{H2233} shall be mighty{H1368} upon earth:{H776} The generation{H1755} of the upright{H3477} shall be blessed.{H1288}
Wealth{H1952} and riches{H6239} are in his house;{H1004} And his righteousness{H6666} endureth{H5975} for ever.{H5703}
Unto the upright{H3477} there ariseth{H2224} light{H216} in the darkness:{H2822} [He is] gracious,{H2587} and merciful,{H7349} and righteous.{H6662}
Well{H2896} is it with the man{H376} that dealeth graciously{H2603} and lendeth;{H3867} He shall maintain{H3557} his cause{H1697} in judgment.{H4941}
For he shall never{H5769} be moved;{H4131} The righteous{H6662} shall be had in everlasting{H5769} remembrance.{H2143}
He shall not be afraid{H3372} of evil{H7451} tidings:{H8052} His heart{H3820} is fixed,{H3559} trusting{H982} in Jehovah.{H3068}
His heart{H3820} is established,{H5564} he shall not be afraid,{H3372} Until he see{H7200} [his desire] upon his adversaries.{H6862}
He hath dispersed,{H6340} he hath given{H5414} to the needy;{H34} His righteousness{H6666} endureth{H5975} for ever:{H5703} His horn{H7161} shall be exalted{H7311} with honor.{H3519}
The wicked{H7563} shall see{H7200} it, and be grieved;{H3707} He shall gnash{H2786} with his teeth,{H8127} and melt away:{H4549} The desire{H8378} of the wicked{H7563} shall perish.{H6}
